title: metadata-protocol: a bare publish of a disabled package's own draft, and a bare rollback with history but no package-less row, still land on a name only disabled packages hold
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① carrier of a should-fix left open by design · Source: fleet (contract-review-tier L2 record 7212193932 on PR #37818, S1; L1-a delta 7212229066)

## What happens (by code read at PR #37818 head 35ca5027dd)

PR #37818 (Fixes #37608) makes the per-item publish and rollback refuse the package-less writes the ruled cell names. Two neighbouring cells stay open, because closing them moves a shipped answer beyond that cell:
- **Bare publish of PKG's own draft** while PKG is disabled and is the only holder of the name: the promotion writes PKG's own active row.
- **Bare rollback with history but no package-less row** on a name only disabled packages hold: the restore lands.
In both cells the bare save of the same item refuses `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`. So the three doors answer differently for the same disabled-only name.

reach: not yet measured beyond the code read; step one is to run both cells on the served stack (the fixture PR #37818 adds).

## Decision owed

Whether these two cells refuse like the save (and the maintainer topic #36229 「我觉得停用就该全部消失」 extends to them), or stay open by design. Changing a shipped answer beyond the ruled cell is the maintainer's call: this card goes to the decision inbox with options after the measurement.

Category ①: two doors disagree with the save door on the same item.
Priority: p1 — same class and grade as #37608. Suggested-grade: p1 · sibling cells of #37608.
Business reason: an admin who disables a package expects its items to stay untouched until re-enable; a publish or rollback that still lands changes what re-enabling brings back, while the save refuses.
Reader: seat repo:objectstack#3 (area:package p1), after PR #37818 merges: measure, then the decision thread.
Blocked-by: #37818 (merge)
Dedupe: searched `disabled package publish rollback package-less` (open and closed issues, 47 hits): #37608 (this card's parent), #37499 (closed, the save-door sibling), #34260 (open, ADR-0150 / docs statement only); no card carries these two cells.
Related: #37608, PR #37818, #37499, PR #37584, #36229.
